This scholarship is for applicants who are a national of India, are classified as 'Overseas' for fee purposes and have been accepted to study an eligible Masters course at Sussex. From 2024, the value of the scholarship has been increased to £4,000.
To be eligible for this scholarship, you must:
Be classified as ‘overseas’ for fee purposes
Be taking up a place on the full time MBA, starting January 2025
Students with an offer to study in the University of Sussex Business School will be able to combine this scholarship with the Business School International Masters Award.
You are not eligible for this scholarship if your full tuition fees will be paid to the university by a sponsor.
You are not eligible for this scholarship if you are going to study any of the following:
Courses at Brighton and Sussex Medical School (BSMS)
Early Years Education (with Early Years Teacher status)
Degrees in Social Work (if receiving an NHS bursary)
Masters funded by the research councils (e.g. ESRC 1+3 funding)
As this scholarship is funded by the University of Sussex, it is not possible to combine this with other Sussex scholarships (e.g. Chancellor's International Scholarship).

You can register your interest in the Sussex India Scholarship via the PG Apply portal when you accept our offer of a place on an eligible Masters course. If you have applied via one of our overseas representatives, you will need to ask them to do this on your behalf.

You must declare your interest in the scholarship via PG Apply before you register on your Masters degree. Information about the scholarship will be included in your CAS (Confirmation of Acceptance for Studies) for your visa application, when it is produced. Please register your interest in this scholarship before the deadline of the 31st January. Once you have registered your interest, via the application portal, there is nothing further that you will need to do to secure the scholarship.
This scholarship is only available until the 31st January for applicants to the MBA for January 2025 entry.
Students who began their study in September 2024 were required to register their interest in the scholarship before the 1st September 2024 deadline.
